adjudication_result.rationale: After reviewing the patch and results, I found that the candidate resolves the public-files root, adds the platform path separator as a directory boundary, and rejects a requested path unless it remains under that root. This blocks the recorded parent traversal and prevents a sibling path with a similar prefix from being accepted. The valid-file control and traversal attack passed, all three functional tests passed, syntax passed, and no new SAST findings appeared. The CWE-22 warning remains around path resolution, but it does not appear to account for the containment check that follows. I accept this candidate for the controlled /file fixture. The conversion with String(name || "") means missing, repeated, and unusual parameter values still deserve supplemental testing, along with encoded paths, platform variations, and symlink behavior.
